name: Episto
description: 🤖 Episto is the AI-powered platform reinventing insight generation. By combining methodological rigor with operational agility, it enables insight teams to: 🎯 recruit authentic respondents, 💬 engage them through a seamless, interactive format, and 💡 analyze results instantly—delivering insights that are more reliable, faster, and truly actionable.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Episto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Episto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.episto.fr/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Episto MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Episto provides these MCP tools: get_aggregated_data, get_completion_filters, get_individual_data, get_results_map, get_survey, get_survey_completion, get_survey_progress, list_survey_questions, and list_surveys.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Episto?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Episto in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Episto requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Episto is developed by Episto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
